'''Skikkivit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who belonged to [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Nebit's tribe/Legends|Nebit's tribe]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Rebel Storm" />

==Biography==
Skikkivit was aboard the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] that found the stranded [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], after they had fled the capture of the ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]]'' aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. After the droids were sold to the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]], [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], Skikkivit traveled to the nearby settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] with nine other Jawas. It was there that he was sought after by both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces for questioning.<ref name="Rebel Storm" />
